name: a_frozen_lake_ice_fishing_village_where
description: A frozen-lake ice-fishing village: red and blue huts on glare ice, dark fishing holes, a wooden dock with a lookout ramp, and a smokehouse yard behind a sluice gate.
theme: a frozen-lake ice-fishing village where the robot crosses glare ice between huts

tasks.name: cross_the_glare_ice
tasks.instruction: Cross the glare ice to the little red hut's door, and keep well clear of the dark open fishing holes.
paraphrases: Walk over the shiny ice to the red hut, minding the holes.
Make your way across the frozen lake to the red hut's doorway without stepping in a fishing hole.

tasks.name: climb_the_lookout
tasks.instruction: Walk west along the wooden dock, go up the little ramp and stand on the lookout deck.
paraphrases: Climb the ramp onto the raised deck at the west end of the dock.
Go up onto the wooden lookout platform above the dock.

tasks.name: smokehouse_sluice
tasks.instruction: Step on the round brass plate by the smokehouse fence to lift the wooden sluice gate, then walk into the smokehouse yard.
paraphrases: Press the brass plate in front of the smokehouse and go through the gate it opens.
Stand on the shiny plate to raise the sluice gate, then enter the smokehouse yard.

tasks.name: roll_the_snowball
tasks.instruction: Push the big snowball across the ice to the blue hut's door.
paraphrases: Roll the snowball over the glare ice to the blue hut.
Shove the snowball all the way up to the blue hut's doorway.

tasks.name: evening_rounds
tasks.instruction: Do the evening rounds: stop at the red hut's door, then visit the fish-drying rack on the grit path, then finish by the lantern on the dock.
paraphrases: Check the red hut, then the fish rack, then the dock lantern.
Go to the red hut's door first, then the drying rack, and end by the glowing dock lantern.

tasks.name: crate_to_the_dock
tasks.instruction: Shove the wooden fish crate off the ice and onto the dock, stopping by the lantern.
paraphrases: Push the fish crate across the ice to the lantern on the dock.
Slide the crate of fish over the frozen lake to the wooden dock.
